page_title: ACM 3-1 BOL | AC Milan v Bologna 09/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
90+2' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box from Samuel Chukwueze and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
90+2' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+1' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Santiago Castro (Bologna).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Mike Maignan, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
87' The fouls committed statistics – 5:14.
84' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
83' Santiago Castro (Bologna) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
82' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
81' Livio Marinelli blows for a foul after Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
80' Substitution. Nikola Moro will be replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
79' 2 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 2:1.
79' Joao Felix (AC Milan) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Loftus-Cheek departs the field of play to be replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
77' Santiago Castro (Bologna) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
75' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
74' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul after Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) hacks down one of his opponents.

73' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic displays great vision and sends a pass to Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.
71' A precise low pass is received by Joao Felix (AC Milan), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
71' One of the AC Milan players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
70' Joao Felix (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
69' AC Milan control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
67' Joao Felix (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Livio Marinelli had an easy-decision to make.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alejandro Jimenez leaves the pitch and Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) comes on.
65' Here is a change. Luka Jovic is going off and Sergio Conceicao gives the last tactical orders to Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).
65' Here's the change. Strahinja Pavlovic leaves the pitch and Kyle Walker (AC Milan) comes on as a substitute.
62' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
61' Substitution. Thijs Dallinga makes his way off the pitch and Santiago Castro (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
61' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Riccardo Orsolini and he is replaced by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
61' It's time for a substitution. Michel Aebischer (Bologna) comes on in place of Tommaso Pobega.
60' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
57' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
56' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. AC Milan will take a corner kick.
55' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
53' A corner kick by AC Milan is thwarted by the well prepared Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna).
52' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
49' 0 - 1 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
47' Remo Freuler (Bologna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Livio Marinelli starts the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+3' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
45+1' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' What a big chance! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
42' Charalampos Lykogiannis swings the cross over. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the right post.
41' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
40' Nikola Moro (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Livio Marinelli signals a foul. AC Milan will take a free kick near the side line.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Remo Freuler (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
37' Livio Marinelli shows the yellow card to Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) for a heavy challenge.
36' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
34' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) sends a chip pass into the box, but Mike Maignan is quickest to intercept the ball.
31' Vincenzo Italiano is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Martin Erlic suffers an injury and Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) comes on.
27' It doesn’t look good for Martin Erlic (Bologna); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
27' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
24' Nikola Moro (Bologna) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

24' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan made a crucial save! Bologna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
22' Livio Marinelli interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna).

19' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than low towards the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
19' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.

18' A terrific piece of skill by Joao Felix (AC Milan) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. AC Milan have a corner.
17' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
16' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
14' Fikayo Tomori looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Sergio Conceicao has decided that Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) is the man to take his place.
12' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) picks up an injury.
9' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
8' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
7' The Bologna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

4' A neat pass is well received by Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli is introduced as the referee for today's match.
